data.narrative:
Radian Forge is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Jeff Yeager that has raised $3M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 9 robotics and manufacturing peers (1 public, 8 private), including companies such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable and forms the primary valuation anchor. Using the $3M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $8M. The Peer-Median approach is not applicable; while 10 same-sector peers exist in the robotics and manufacturing space, insufficient narrowly-filtered comparables (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier) are available to support a robust median benchmark. A broader sector median would lack precision for Seed-stage positioning.

Based on Stage-Progression methodology alone, the analysis supports a valuation range of $6M (low) to $9M (high), with a median of $8M. Key uncertainties include the limited applicability of peer comparables at the Seed stage and reliance on a single methodological pillar. Additional validation through revenue-based or capability-based metrics would strengthen conviction if such data become available in future rounds.
